720-1806-2034-5933.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-5933.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

862-5006-5256-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

539-3821-4050-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4050-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding one mana of any color.

6-1432-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-1432-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

413-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
413-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

728-2018--73.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-2018--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

465-3817-8095.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2021-2060-3921-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1263-2438-4871-4976.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4659-7692.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Repeat.

2921-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2921-4302-4875.description:

When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

225-2713-4050-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {G} due to Zirda and tapping it, earthbending another land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the other earthbent land, adding {G}.

When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Ba Sing Se.
Repeat.

567-3490-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3490-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3259-4460-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-4460-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-4460-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1409-2557-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

775-1409-1770.description:

When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve both Jewel Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4488-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4488-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.

When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.

Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens equal to the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Earthcraft three times by tapping two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens and Prossh, untapping a basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

It is your precombat main phase.

Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.

Repeat each combat phase.

The Riftsweeper token enters the battlefield, shuffling the nontoken Riftsweeper into your library from exile.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger from step 2, searching your library for Riftsweeper and putting it onto the battlefield.
Riftsweeper enters the battlefield, shuffling any exiled card into its owner's library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {3}.
Squee enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.

Cast Corpse Cur.
When Corpse Cur ETBs, Corpse Cur and Molten Echoes trigger.
Allow the Corpse Cur trigger to fizzle.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corpse Cur, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Corpse Cur.
The token copy of Corpse Cur triggers on ETB, returning the original Corpse Cur to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token copy of Corpse Cur, adding {C}{C} Repeat.
